title: Data Migration Analyst - CANBERRA based
text: Data Migration Analyst - CANBERRA based at Full Circle Partners (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: Market rate $$ or maximum of $800 pd.). Full Circle Partners are a leading specialist ICT recruitment consultancy providing Consulting and Systems Implementation services to clients across Australia and Asia Pacific. Our client is seeking a Data Migration Analyst to join their technology team. This role will define, apply and implement the ODI scripts required to support the Data Cleansing, transformation and load into the Oracle applications. This is CANBERRA based position. Responsibilities: Design and Develop data scripting for the OUAF/Oracle ODI application. Work collaboratively with business and project stakeholders to guide data migration development. Support and co-ordinate data migration decision making between internal and external project staff. Develop and maintain data migration scripts and documentation. Participate in project sprint planning and closure activities. Required skills: Demonstrated Experience working in data migration, ETL processes, data cleansing and validation on large Oracle ERP programs. An accomplished Data Analyst with experience (2 years+) developing and implementing data migration solutions using the Oracle ODI product, (including demonstrated experience working within an asset intensive industry implementation project). Experience working with (or demonstrated understanding of) the Oracle Utility Application Framework. Experience in all stages of a product, platform or systems development lifecycle. Experience working within the Agile methodology and ability to participate within all Agile ceremonies. Demonstrated relationship with the Oracle Product Group to support the timely resolution of data design decisions, e.g. Business Object load decisions. Benefits: 7 months contract Condusive working environment Canberra location Interstates candidates are encouraged to apply. Only candidates with full Australian working rights.
